workflow_runs.display_title: feat(ml): implement Block B model evolution

head_commit.message:
feat(ml): implement Block B model evolution

- Added 9 biophysical features (VPD via Tetens formula, DTR, FWI hazard proxy)
- Implemented multi-horizon forecasting for 1-day (24h), 3-day (72h), and 7-day windows
- Trained and calibrated dedicated LightGBM models with Platt scaling across horizons
- Built and evaluated sequential PyTorch LSTM benchmark (T=14 days)
- Integrated multi-horizon selection in FastAPI (/predict) and Streamlit sidebar
- Added unit tests for multi-horizon API and LSTM forward pass (17 passed)
- Re-executed modeling notebook embedding all benchmark and comparison curves

workflow_runs.name: CI Pipeline
workflow_runs.display_title: feat(ml): implement Block A scientific rigor improvements

head_commit.message:
feat(ml): implement Block A scientific rigor improvements

- Fixed target boundary condition for the final 7 days of historical data
- Replaced heuristic persistence with empirical conditional risk baseline
- Implemented Contiguous Spatial Block Cross-Validation across 3 latitudinal regions
- Switched to Platt Scaling (logistic sigmoid) for calibration, dropping Brier to 0.0941
- Added 1,000-sample bootstrap 95% confidence intervals and paired significance test (p < 0.001)
- Implemented 5-year walk-forward expanding window validation (2021-2025)
- Added spatial and monthly error analysis
- Added bounding box validation in API and updated Streamlit app
- Added Windows PowerShell pipeline script (run_pipeline.ps1) and GitHub Actions CI
